message.content: Based on the conversation, Dyllan recommended "Persona 5 Royal" for turn-based combat and praised its art style. Specifically, Dyllan mentioned that "Persona 5 Royal" has a unique vibe, a unique combat system with a blend of RPG elements and social simulation, and a very engaging and visually appealing art style. He particularly enjoyed the characters and their development in the game, finding it fun to balance daily life and dungeons. No other game specific to turn-based combat and art style was mentioned by Dyllan.
